issue.title: Check merged 🪢 LINKED FROM row usability once mentions are in daily use; split mentions to their own row if confusing

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #5; listed in the "Follow-ups" section of plan 202610/inline_task_mentions.md (epic bob-cli-e8), matching the research report's reopen trigger.

bob-cli-e8 merged inert `(💬 mentions)` entries into the existing 🪢 LINKED FROM row (relations first, a dotted divider, then mention rows with `💬 mentioned in` / `💬 embedded in` pills). Mentions shipped enabled by default (relations.linked_from_mentions: true) on 2026-10-30. The e8.9 pilot could not run `npm run smoke:obsidian` on apollo (no /snap/bin/obsidian), so no human visual check of the rows, pills, quote line, and context card has happened yet.

Proposal: after Bryan has used the feature for a while, check whether he can tell at a glance why each LINKED FROM entry exists (relation vs mention vs embed), in light and dark themes, in Live Preview and Reading view. If he cannot, move mentions to a separate typed row; the typed relation/mention kinds in Rust and both plugins make that migration mechanical.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Needs Bryan's judgment after real use of the shipped feature; the bob-cli-e8 plan listed this usability check under Follow-ups rather than as an epic phase.

issue.creation_reason: Out-of-scope follow-up named in the bob-cli-e8 plan and proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #5; it is the research report's reopen trigger and no human visual check has happened yet.
